manifests.learnerOutcome: Use graphing, bracketing, and numerical methods for trig equations without convenient exact solutions.
manifests.mathematicalClaim: Graphs locate intersections and estimate root counts. Bracketing methods preserve evidence that a root lies in an interval, while faster iterative methods require good starting values and may converge to unexpected roots.
